result.rationale: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns `refreshTokenResponse` (the full zod safeParse wrapper, e.g. {success, data}), not `.data`. In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff assigns `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and immediately persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, so every Google credential refresh stores the wrapper object instead of the parsed credential, corrupting stored keys. Similarly other callers must handle the wrapper, but the Google path clearly persists it directly.
